Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Gopabandhu Science College to complete the application. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Gopabandhu Science College Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Guest Faculty positions at Gopabandhu Science College is 05 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: To be eligible, candidates must be retired teachers from any University or Degree College, including Government, Aided Colleges (488 & 662 Category), or Sanskrit Colleges.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Guest Faculty posts is 69 years. There are no minimum age requirements specified for these positions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Guest Faculty roles?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Guest Faculty positions will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 25,000 to Rs. 50,000.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: Gopabandhu Science College is recruiting for a total of 18 Guest Faculty positions across various subjects.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the Gopabandhu Science College Guest Faculty recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official portal.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates (General/OBC, SC/ST) for these Guest Faculty positions.

faq.question: Q8. What are the selection criteria for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a scrutiny of documents followed by an interaction session before the Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q9. When does the online application process start?
faq.answer: The online application process for the Gopabandhu Science College Guest Faculty recruitment begins on 25 August 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section on this page. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.
